Assignment.description: A fact about the situation that the test case sets.

value.description: Context value id on an occasion, exchange or setting dimension. A fact about the person belongs in the persona, and assigning one here is an error
value.title: Value

Assignment.title: Assignment

BehaviorAssertion.description: What the person is expected to do in this conversation, for one expected behavior.

assertion.description: The specific form the behavior takes in this conversation, checkable against a transcript. Whether a transcript is valid is judged against the catalog behavior; this says whether the scenario played as written
assertion.title: Assertion

BehaviorAssertion.title: BehaviorAssertion

KlPin.description: Which Knowledge Library a run, result, or test case was produced against.

digest.description: Content hash of the loaded entries
digest.title: Digest

KlPin.title: KlPin

Provenance.description:
How a record was made, as its producer records it.

Only ``kind`` has a fixed meaning. Any other key is the producer's own record (a
design row, the model call that wrote the text, a name replacement) and is checked
by the producer's tooling, not by these models.

kind.description: 'authored' by a person, 'generated' by a program, or 'imported' from another dataset
kind.title: Kind

Provenance.title: Provenance

ScenarioStrategy.description: Something the simulated person does in this conversation, and when.

strategy.description: What the person does, in plain words
strategy.title: Strategy

available_from_turn.description: The first user turn, 1-indexed, at which the person may do it
available_from_turn.title: Available From Turn

trigger.description: What in the conversation prompts it, in plain words: something the AI does, something the person has said, or 'none'. A strategy whose trigger never happens is not expected to occur
trigger.title: Trigger

ScenarioStrategy.title: ScenarioStrategy

description:
A test case: a person, a scenario, and the route through the catalog it tests.

A test case is complete enough to simulate. Transcripts are separate records that
name the test case they came from.

version.description: Semver version of this test case. Copied onto the transcript and checked when a judge run joins the two
version.title: Version

created_at.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time of test case creation
created_at.title: Created At

display_name.description: Short human-readable name for dashboard display
display_name.title: Display Name

description.description: Human-readable summary for review and dashboards. Not read by the pipeline
description.title: Description

provenance.description: How the test case was made. A rewrite names the case it came from under 'derived_from' and lists its edits under 'changes'. Not read by the pipeline

pathway_id.description: Catalog pathway this test case tests
pathway_id.title: Pathway Id

kl.description: The library the pathway and every catalog id in the test case are read from

assignments.description: Facts about the scenario the test case sets, possibly none. Facts about the person are the persona's
assignments.title: Assignments

scenario.description: The situation that brings the person to the conversation, in prose. Read by the simulator and the fidelity check. Not sent to judges or to the system under test
scenario.title: Scenario

turns.description: Ordered user turns. The first is the opening message
turns.title: Turns

scenario_strategies.description: What the person does as the conversation goes. Read by the simulator and the fidelity check
scenario_strategies.title: Scenario Strategies

setup_behaviors.description: Catalog user behaviors the person must show that the pathway does not state, possibly none: for a pathway whose person-side turn is not one of its parts
setup_behaviors.title: Setup Behaviors

behavior_assertions.description: One per expected behavior (the pathway's user-behavior parts plus setup_behaviors): what the person does in this conversation. Read by the simulator and the fidelity check
behavior_assertions.title: Behavior Assertions
